decisionRationale: Ananke can host a bounded local fixture adapter, but the pinned Horae and Moirae Code surfaces are inspection-only and contain no real dispatch, forwarding, or result-relay boundary for the required route.

preferredTopology.reason: No existing topology crosses Moirae Code to Horae to Ananke without bypassing Horae, using a mock/direct package shortcut, or broadening the bounded fixture authority.

contractAssessment: Existing Adrasteia types cover identity, dual principals, bounded scope, capability/action identifiers, correlation, protocol compatibility, readiness and generic results. Route-specific origin/schema receipts and Ananke decision details remain domain-local unless a demonstrated multi-runtime structural gap is approved.

blockingFindings.finding: The Ananke and gateway bindings expose inspect() only; SessionOrchestrator is validation/composition only and has no dispatch or result relay.
blockingFindings.activationImpact: Horae cannot honestly participate in the claimed route or enforce fresh readiness at dispatch.

blockingFindings.finding: Stage-A Ananke mutation and Horae session methods explicitly fail closed; the extension and IPC surfaces are inspection-only/scaffolded.
blockingFindings.activationImpact: No constrained request origin or typed result receiver exists.

blockingFindings.finding: The Gateway has a generic executor pipeline but no registered fixed-fixture adapter that performs one controlled read and post-read digest verification.
blockingFindings.activationImpact: The candidate action cannot yet prove Ananke controls the physical read.

blockingFindings.finding: No cross-runtime harness currently proves origin/schema binding, freshness before dispatch, correlation/producer preservation, or route-specific bypass closure.
blockingFindings.activationImpact: The six activation gates cannot receive real evidence.

requiredOwnerApprovals: Horae owner approval for one bounded, non-durable governed-action handoff/relay boundary, including selected transport, delegation, freshness and failure semantics.
Ananke owner approval for the exact registered action, Ananke-owned immutable fixture, policy treatment, read-attempt audit and post-read digest enforcement.
Moirae Code owner approval for a restricted test host that calls Horae only and exposes remaining bypass limitations.
Adrasteia owner confirmation that no portable contract change is currently required, with escalation only for a proven shared structural gap.
Integration owner approval of acceptance evidence, negative tests, checkpoint/handoff requirements and later sealing conditions.
minimumRepositoryOrder: Integration: freeze expected fixture digest and acceptance evidence without becoming a runtime fixture or transport.
Ananke: implement and test a local fixed-fixture adapter behind the existing authority gateway; publish a clean, green checkpoint and handoff packet.
Horae: implement and test the narrowly approved, fail-closed dispatch/readiness/relay boundary against the Ananke checkpoint; publish a clean, green checkpoint and handoff packet.
Moirae Code: implement and test a constrained origin/result host that uses Horae only; publish a clean, green checkpoint and handoff packet.
Integration: run real cross-runtime positive and negative proof against exact checkpoints before any compatibility-state advancement.

evidence.finding: Policy denial returns before executor invocation; a generic registered executor exists, but no fixed-fixture adapter exists.
Inspection, registration, readiness and composition exist; action dispatch and result relay do not.
Stage-A is an inspection host; mutation/session operations fail closed and bypass surfaces remain documented.
Portable structural vocabulary is available; it is not a transport or policy implementation.
Memory is intentionally out of scope for this no-memory-dependency candidate.
